message.content: I've read the full 10-K and verified the reported figures. Apple's FY2024 (ended 2024-09-28) shows record revenue of $391.0B (+2% y/y), record operating income of $123.2B (up from $114.3B), record operating cash flow of $118.3B (from $110.3B), and gross margin expansion to 46.2% from 44.1%, with Services up 13% to $96.2B. Diluted EPS of $6.08 and net income of $93.7B are down y/y, but that is driven by the one-time $10.2B State Aid tax charge — a non-operating item, not an operating deterioration. With $140.8B in unrestricted cash and $95B returned via buybacks, the business is fundamentally in excellent shape. Buying within the mandate.
message.reasoning:
